component.name: OneKeePass
component.summary: KeePass-compatible password manager for local .kdbx vaults

description.p: This is a community package of OneKeePass, maintained independently. It repackages the official upstream build unmodified.
OneKeePass is a cross-platform password manager that works directly with KeePass .kdbx databases. Your vault is a file on your own disk — there is no account and no server involved.

ul.li: Reads and writes standard KeePass .kdbx vaults
Organise entries by categories, groups, tags and entry types
Custom entry types and custom fields
SSH key entry type and SSH agent support

description.p: By default this package can read and write only your Documents folder. If your vault lives elsewhere, grant that directory:

ul.li: A sync folder: flatpak override --user --filesystem=~/Dropbox io.github.onekeepass.desktop
A dedicated vault directory: flatpak override --user --filesystem=~/vaults io.github.onekeepass.desktop
Your whole home (widest, only if you want it): flatpak override --user --filesystem=home io.github.onekeepass.desktop

description.p: Important: grant the directory that contains the vault, never the .kdbx file on its own. A single-file permission becomes a bind mount inside the sandbox, and OneKeePass saves by writing a temporary file and renaming it over the original — that rename cannot replace a mount point, so a file-level grant makes saving fail.

Browser integration is not wired up in this package: connecting the bundled native-messaging helper would require writing into your browser's own directory, which this package deliberately does not request.
